tool.name: ParaFEM Mesh Format Converter
tool.description: Convert Gmsh, VTK, Salome, etc. to Abaqus .inp for ParaFEM

param.name: input_mesh
param.label: Input Mesh File
param.help: Supported formats: Gmsh (.msh), VTK (.vtk, .vtu), Salome (.unv), etc.

param.name: input_format
param.label: Input Mesh Format (optional)
param.help: Manually specify the input format if it's not detected by file extension.

tool.help:
Converts various external mesh formats to Abaqus .inp format using the meshio library. This .inp file can then be imported into ParaFEM using the ParaFEM Mesh Import tool.
**Supported input formats include:** - Gmsh (.msh) - VTK (.vtk, .vtu) - Salome (.unv) - H5M - Exodus - many others...
The converter focuses on 3D volumetric elements (hexahedrons and tetrahedrons) suitable for ParaFEM simulations.
